**Risk flags:**  
- Director 1 holds 66.06 % of shares  

**Overview:**  
Indah Bestari Hotel Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited boutique hotel operating in the Klang Valley, Selangor. The company was incorporated on 8 July 2018, giving it roughly eight years of operating history. It has three directors; Director 1 is the dominant shareholder with a 66.06 % stake and there are no corporate shareholders.  

Financially, the hotel reported revenues of RM 35.8 million (2022) rising to RM 38.8 million (2024) with profit after tax around RM 2.5 million each year. Current ratios range from 3.1 to 3.9 and interest coverage stays above 14×, with unqualified audit opinions for all three years.
